pl-l4d50c5-d1e115.summary: Asks whether those in glory and those in hell see each other.

pl-l4d50c5-d1e118.summary: Answers with the saints that until the judgment the good see the bad and the bad the good; after the judgment the good will see the bad, but not the bad the good.
claims: After the judgment only the blessed see the damned.

pl-l4d50c5-d1e121.summary: Cites Gregory: the unbelievers placed below see the faithful at rest above before the day of judgment, whose joys they will not be able to contemplate afterward.

pl-l4d50c5.summary: Asks whether those in glory and those in hell see each other. The saints teach that until the judgment the good see the bad and the bad the good; after the judgment the good will see the bad, but not the bad the good, as Gregory says the unbelievers below now see the faithful at rest above, whose joys they will not later contemplate.
claims: Before the judgment the blessed and the damned see each other.
After the judgment only the blessed see the damned.
